name: Sleep Cycle Calculator
description: Find the best bedtime or wake-up time using 90-minute sleep cycles. Private and works offline.

name: To-Do List
description: Free to-do list with no registration. Works offline.

name: Heartbeat Sound
description: Heartbeat sound for sleep, babies and puppies. Plays with the screen locked.

name: Bill Splitter
description: Split a bill and see who owes who. Email the summary. Also a tip calculator.

name: Weather App
description: Weather forecast for any city or your location, with advice. No API key.

name: Due Date Calculator
description: Pregnancy due date and weeks pregnant today from your last period, conception, IVF or scan. Email it or add to calendar.

name: Time Zone Meeting Planner
description: Find a meeting time across time zones, even when people work different hours.

name: Work Hours Calculator
description: Weekly timesheet: total hours, overtime and pay from start, finish and break each day. Handles night shifts.

name: Paint Calculator
description: How much paint to buy for your rooms, and which tins. Each room has its own size, doors, windows, coats and colour.

name: Subscription Tracker
description: See what your subscriptions cost per month and per year, what is due next and when free trials end. Private, no sign-up.

name: Hourly to Salary Converter
description: Turn any pay into per hour, day, week, month and year, with holidays, unpaid days off and overtime. Compare job offers.

name: Loan and Credit Card Payoff Planner
description: When will you be debt-free? Add your loans and credit cards and see the date, the interest, what to pay this month and how much paying extra saves.

name: Grocery List with Running Total
description: Tick items off as you shop and see what is in your trolley, what the whole list costs and what is left of your budget.

name: Photo Size Reducer for Online Forms
description: Make a photo smaller than the size a form allows, like 50 KB or 200 KB, with an optional minimum and exact pixels. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Recipe Scaler and Unit Converter
description: Cook a recipe for more or fewer people in easy kitchen measures, and turn cups into grams or grams into cups. Save your recipes.

name: Medication Tracker
description: Tap Taken when you take a dose and see what is taken today, what is due next and when the next dose is safe. Warns about double doses. Private.

name: Trip Packing Checklist
description: A packing list for your trip with how many of each to pack, one list per person. Tick things off as you pack. Private, no sign-up.

name: Age and Date Difference Calculator
description: Exact age in years, months and days on any date, days and working days between two dates, and the date after adding days or months. Save birthdays and deadlines.

name: Signature Maker for Forms
description: Sign on the screen or photograph your signature on paper, and get a clean signature file in the exact pixels and KB a form asks for, like 140 × 60 px, 10 to 20 KB. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Document Scanner to PDF
description: Photograph paper pages, crop and clean them, put them in order and save one PDF under the size you need, like 2 MB. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Expense and Budget Tracker
description: Log what you spend by category, set a monthly budget for each, and see what is left, how much you can spend a day and a warning before you go over.

name: Savings Goal Planner
description: See exactly how much to save each month or week to reach your goal by a date, or when a set amount gets you there. Several goals, money in and out, interest.

name: Unit Price Calculator for Shopping
description: Which pack is cheaper? Type the price and size of each one, in any unit, and see the price per kg, litre or item, the cheapest, and how much more the others cost. Multipacks too.

name: Invoice Generator for Freelancers
description: Make an invoice and print it or save it as a PDF. Discount, tax, deposit, numbers that count up, saved clients. No sign-up.

name: QR Code Generator for Links and Wi-Fi
description: Make a QR code for a link, your Wi-Fi, a contact, a phone number, a text message or an email. Never expires, no sign-up, nothing uploaded. PNG, SVG or print.

name: Baby Feeding and Nappy Tracker
description: Log breast feeds with a timer for each side, bottles, nappies and sleep. See when the last feed was and which side is next. Twins too.

name: Shift Work Calendar
description: Enter your rotating rota once (4 on 4 off, days and nights, Pitman, DuPont, 24 on 48 off or your own) and see your shift on any date, your next day off, and the days you and your partner are both off.

name: Home Blood Pressure Log
description: Type each blood pressure reading and see your average, morning and evening averages and what the numbers mean (UK/Europe or US guide). Print or email the list for your doctor.

name: Daily Habit and Water Tracker
description: Tap to log glasses of water and daily habits, see what is left for today, your streaks and your week. Every day, some days or 3 times a week.

name: Money Lent and Borrowed Tracker
description: Write down money you lend to friends and family, or borrow. Each person shows what they still owe, with part repayments, pay-back-by dates and a reminder message.

name: Prayer Times and Qibla Direction
description: Today's five prayer times for your city with a countdown to the next one, a month timetable to print and the Qibla direction. Hanafi or standard Asr, works offline.

name: Fuel Log and Car Running Cost Tracker
description: Log each fill-up and car cost. See your fuel use per tank (km/L, L/100 km or mpg), fuel cost per km or mile, all running costs and what you spent this month. Several cars.

name: Study Planner and Exam Countdown
description: Add your exams and their topics. See the days left to each exam and a day-by-day study plan that fits every topic in before the exam, with revision days.

name: Weekly Meal Planner with Shopping List
description: Pick what you eat each day of the week and for how many people. Get one shopping list with every ingredient added up and sorted by aisle, to tick off, copy or email.

name: Chore Rota for Households
description: Add the people and the chores and get a fair weekly rota that rotates by itself, with heavy jobs counted as more work. Mark someone away, swap a job, tick jobs done, copy or print it.

name: Warranty and Return Deadline Tracker
description: Add what you bought and when, and see the last day to return it and when its warranty ends, most urgent first. Keep a receipt photo, add calendar reminders and copy the details for a claim.

name: Time Tracker for Freelancers
description: Start a timer for a client or add time afterwards, and see the hours and money per client, each with its own rate and rounding. Copy the hours as invoice lines and mark them as billed.

name: Contraction Timer for Labour
description: Tap when a contraction starts and ends. See how long and how far apart they are, and a plain answer when your 5-1-1 rule (or your own) is reached. Note when waters break and send the log to your midwife.

name: Net Worth Tracker
description: List what you own and what you owe, update the balances once a month and see your net worth, the change since last time and a line over time. No bank login, private, works offline.

name: Period and Ovulation Calendar
description: Tap the day each period starts and see when the next one is due, your likely fertile days and ovulation, and if your period is late. Private, on your device.

name: Spaced Repetition Flashcards for Exams
description: Paste your notes as flashcards and study only the cards due today. Each card comes back just before you would forget it, and an exam date makes sure every card is reviewed in time. No account, private, works offline.
